baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated predicate links المتقين (و ق ي), ظلال (ظ ل ل), and عيون (ع ي ن).
baseline_models.mechanism: Self-guarding is answered by an environment that itself guards: overhead covering blocks exposure while springing water sustains life, so the two plurals form one protective microclimate rather than two ornaments.

activation_trace.role: Placing the self in protective caution supplies the human side of the reciprocal guarding mechanism.
The overhead-canopy image turns the plural shades into layered environmental cover.
The springing water-eye supplies renewable water within the covered habitat.

changed_reading.before: The God-conscious are amid pleasant shade and springs.
changed_reading.after: Those who placed themselves in protective caution inhabit a layered, water-fed system that performs protection around them.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same nouns ظلال and عيون can carry relational branches while المتقين remains the protected cohort.
baseline_models.mechanism: Shade functions as patronage and the eye as watchful care; together they make the locative phrase a relation of custody, honor, and attentive presence, not only a landscape description.

activation_trace.role: Protective caution identifies the people who enter the relation of custody.
Protective shelter and patronage converts shade into defended social space.
The eye of watchful care adds active attention to the shelter's protection.

changed_reading.before: Shade and springs are impersonal amenities.
changed_reading.after: The protected are under patronage and watchful care, with the natural scene also carrying a custodial relation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ظلال is read through the branch of nearness as overshadowing, and عيون through direct face-to-face seeing.
baseline_models.mechanism: A thing drawing near casts its shade before arrival, while the eye marks direct encounter; the clause can therefore stage movement from anticipated protection into immediate protective presence.

activation_trace.role: Approach as overshadowing makes shade the advance sign of a nearing reality.
Face-to-face seeing supplies arrival into immediacy rather than remote anticipation.
A protective barrier keeps the approaching presence beneficial rather than threatening.

changed_reading.before: The verse fixes a static garden location.
changed_reading.after: The verse may also mark the arrival of a protection that had drawn near and is now directly present.

context_deltas.mechanism: The early sequence makes the promised event temporally fixed and certain to settle into fact. That sequence strengthens the focus-only approach model: the protective overshadowing of 77:41 can be heard as one realized face of the event that had been approaching.

activation_trace.role: Approach as casting a shadow anchors the temporal activation back in the focus noun.
Face-to-face seeing marks the transition from promise to direct presence.
A promise bounded by time or place supplies the anticipated event.
Falling and becoming fixed converts anticipation into realized fact.
Temporal delimitation makes realization scheduled rather than indefinite.
The appointed endpoint completes the movement toward arrival.

structural_cues: 77:7 asserts certainty, and 77:11-14 repeatedly fixes the event to an appointed day.
The focus assertion arrives only after the promised event has been repeatedly treated as present judgment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies promise, occurrence, timing, and endpoint; I infer that their certainty also frames the protected outcome in 77:41, while the live alternative is that they name only judgment as such and do not temporalize this particular image.

changed_reading.before: The protected scene is detached from the surah's opening promise.
changed_reading.after: The protected scene can be read as the now-present beneficial outcome of what was promised and timed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The creation sequence moves water into a stable, capable place, then presents earth as a containing vessel and fresh water as deliberately delivered. It turns the focus shades and springs into the culminating version of a recurring life-support architecture: containment, stability, cover, and potable flow.

activation_trace.role: Warding harm with a barrier anchors the habitat's containing and protective function.
Shaded retained water or grove fuses cover and water into one ecological niche.
The flowing spring-eye supplies the habitat's renewable water source.
Seminal water in the womb begins the sequence with life-bearing fluid inside an enclosure.
Fixity and settlement supply the stable-container function.
A place of being makes the enclosure an inhabitable location.
Gathering and holding within a vessel extends containment from womb to earth.
Quenching a drinker makes water an intentionally delivered provision.
Sweet fresh water specifies the life-supporting quality of the flow.

structural_cues: 77:20-27 progresses from enclosed generative water to containing earth, fixed mountains, and supplied fresh water.
77:41 recombines enclosure and water in one compact plural predicate.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated containers, stability, and delivered fresh water; I infer a compositional architecture culminating in 77:41, while the live alternative is that 77:20-27 is an independent creation proof rather than a designed precursor to the focus scene.

changed_reading.before: Shade and springs are a decorative reward inventory.
changed_reading.after: Shade and springs are the mature form of a designed secure habitat whose recurring operations are containment, stabilization, and life-giving flow.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier destination has the shape and name of shade but is explicitly denied both shade-function and sufficiency against flame. The focus plural is therefore read contrastively as genuine cover: shade is defined by whether it actually wards harm, not by whether it merely resembles a canopy.

activation_trace.role: Barrier-based protection supplies the functional test that true shade must pass.
Shade as covering anchors the focus image in actual shelter.
The overhead-canopy image shows that a shade-shaped structure can still fail as protection.
Negated covering function provides the direct lexical foil to the focus shades.
Sufficiency names the protective function that the false shade lacks.
The tongue of flame is the concrete harm against which shelter is tested.

structural_cues: 77:30-31 and 77:41 repeat the shade lexeme on opposite sides of the judgment sequence.
The false shade receives two explicit functional negations; the focus shades are unnegated and assigned to المتقين.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact lexical recurrence plus explicit failure to shade or suffice; I infer that the later unnegated plural is the efficacious counter-image, while the live alternative is a simpler destination contrast without a theory of what counts as shade.

changed_reading.before: The verse promises ordinary relief from heat.
changed_reading.after: The verse names the only kind of shade that counts in this surah: a covering that genuinely suffices against destructive exposure.

context_deltas.mechanism: All parties are gathered, a judicial boundary separates them, and defensive plotting is challenged as powerless. The focus locative is thus a post-verdict placement, and the self-protection in المتقين is distinguished from tactical self-rescue: effective shelter is assigned protection, not a successful escape scheme.

activation_trace.role: Placing the self in moral caution supplies the disposition that must be distinguished from last-minute evasion.
Protective patronage supplies the assigned status reached after separation.
Judgment separating truth from falsehood supplies the allocation boundary.
Gathering the dispersed creates the common population that is then sorted.
Plotting and contrivance supplies the failed alternative mode of self-protection.

structural_cues: 77:38 gathers and names the day of separation; 77:39 challenges any scheme; 77:41 immediately assigns a protected location after the refrain.
The move from second-person challenge to third-person المتقين marks a cohort switch at the placement boundary.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gathering, judicial separation, failed plotting, and then protected location; I infer that the location is an allocated verdict and that taqwa is not tactical evasion, while the live alternative is that 77:41 merely begins an unrelated reward vignette.

changed_reading.before: The self-guarding appear to have secured a refuge by their own defensive capacity.
changed_reading.after: Their prior moral guarding culminates in protection assigned after judgment, precisely where improvised schemes cannot rescue anyone.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following verses activate the focus setting as hospitality in use: fruit is supplied, water is drunk without harm, and the invitation is explicitly tied to intentional deeds and recompense for doing good. Springs become accessible provision and shade becomes the venue of an enacted reward relation.

activation_trace.role: Protective shelter and ease of life make shade the venue of hospitality.
Flowing springs provide the liquid resource consumed in the next verse.
Choice fruit turns the environment into supplied nourishment.
Actual intake of liquid converts springs from scenery into usable provision.
Enjoyment without hardship or ill effect specifies the provision's benign quality.
Intentional action supplies the stated basis for the invitation.
Matching an act with its recompense defines the scene as a response rather than a bare gift inventory.
Doing what is good characterizes the rewarded cohort by enacted excellence.

structural_cues: 77:41 supplies location, 77:42 supplies desired food, 77:43 issues the eating and drinking invitation, and 77:44 names recompense.
The causal بما in 77:43 directly links enjoyment to prior action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered hospitality sequence and its explicit causal and recompense language; I infer that المتقين in 77:41 and المحسنين in 77:44 are overlapping descriptions of the local beneficiaries, while the live alternative is that the labels remain adjacent but extensionally distinct.

changed_reading.before: The verse inventories a reward landscape before any action occurs within it.
changed_reading.after: The verse opens an enacted hospitality scene in which protective space and flowing water are consumed as fitting recompense for intentional good action.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same command to eat appears for the protected and for the criminals, but the latter consumption is enclosed by slightness and culpability. This contrast makes the focus habitat one side of two temporal economies: sustainable, benign provision versus consumption under a shrinking limit.

activation_trace.role: Covering that can be lasting supplies a possible durable horizon for protected enjoyment.
A springing source suggests renewed supply rather than a consumed finite stock.
Culpable wrongdoing identifies the cohort whose enjoyment is restricted.
Eating by the protected supplies the first member of the repeated imperative pair.
Repeated eating by the criminals makes the two consumption scenes directly comparable.
Continued retention for enjoyment supplies the duration that is immediately curtailed.
Smallness and paucity impose the explicit limit on the second consumption scene.

structural_cues: The imperative كلوا occurs at 77:43 and again at 77:46, but only the latter is modified by قليلا and followed by إنكم مجرمون.
The protected scene uses plural resources and no limiting adverb.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated eating commands and an explicit limit only for the criminal cohort; I infer a contrast in duration and renewability, while the live alternative is that the contrast concerns moral quality alone and 77:41 itself makes no claim of permanence.

changed_reading.before: The focus scene differs from criminal enjoyment only in the kind of goods offered.
changed_reading.after: Its shade and springs suggest a renewable mode of enjoyment set against culpable consumption whose remaining span is explicitly slight.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the nearby drinking command makes springs the primary sense of عيون. It remains anchored in the packet's explicit watchful-eye branch and the shade-as-patronage branch, while the preceding speech prohibition and gathering make a seeing-versus-speaking resonance possible. Downstream prose should present it only as a secondary custodial or evidentiary overtone, never as a replacement for springs.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: عيون carries the eye of watchful care, coordinated with ظلال as protective patronage.

activation_trace.role: The watchful eye supports an overtone of attentive custody or witnessed presence.
Patronage gives the possible watching a protective rather than punitive function.
The removal of speech creates the cross-modal pressure toward witnessed rather than argued presence.
Withholding permission closes the route of verbal self-defense.
Gathering everyone supplies the public setting in which presence can itself be witnessed.

changed_reading.after: Alongside its primary spring sense, عيون may resonate as watchful care in a judgment scene where failed speakers are gathered and the protected stand under patronage.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation is branch-distant because it uses the non-dominant س ق ي mapping to a driving or dispatching image rather than the dominant quenching branch. It remains anchored in عيون as flowing springs and in the packet-authorized split mapping for أسقيناكم. Downstream prose should qualify it as a hydraulic conveyance analogy, not as the lexical meaning of either focus noun.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: عيون is anchored in the flowing spring-eye, with ظلال supplying the receiving shaded habitat.

activation_trace.role: The flowing spring-eye supplies the water source whose motion is being reconsidered.
Shaded retained water supplies a destination where conducted flow becomes habitat.
The non-dominant image of driving and dispatching makes provision directional rather than static.

changed_reading.before: The springs are stationary objects already present in the scene.
changed_reading.after: The springs may be imagined as a conducted supply network that drives fresh water into and through the shaded habitat.

strongest_changes: The failed shade of 77:30-31 makes protective efficacy, rather than canopy shape, the defining feature of the focus shades.
The womb-earth-water sequence of 77:20-27 changes the scene into a designed secure habitat built from containment, stability, and potable flow.
Gathering, judicial separation, and failed stratagem in 77:38-39 recast the locative phrase as assigned post-verdict protection rather than successful self-rescue.
The eating, drinking, action, and recompense sequence of 77:42-44 turns static scenery into enacted hospitality.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet exposed two unusually precise structures around the compact focus clause: an earlier counterfeit shade that fails its function, and a long material sequence in which protected containers and delivered water recur before shade and springs are finally joined. The immediate mirror of two eating commands then added a temporal and moral contrast that a short local window could miss.
remaining_uncertainties: The spring sense of عيون is strongly favored by 77:43, so eye, presence, and watchful-care branches should remain secondary resonances.
The contrast with قليلا supports but does not prove permanence for the focus provision.
The opening promise certainly frames judgment, but its direct temporal scope over the specific protected image remains inferential.
The non-dominant س ق ي to driving activation is useful only as a contained material analogy.
